steps.title: Start with the total
steps.text: The city paid $644 million to nonprofits in FY2025. This dashboard follows that money to the organizations and back to their finances.

steps.title: Three departments do most of it
steps.text: Public Health, HSH and HSA contract out large services. Watch the shift toward homelessness after FY2020.

steps.title: Zoom to homelessness
steps.text: Filtering to one service area shows how concentrated it is in a few organizations.

steps.title: Who depends on the city
steps.text: Large and dependent organizations carry the city's operational risk. Top-right is the group to watch.

steps.title: Pay and reserves
steps.text: Pay tracks size. Reserves are the accountability issue: many organizations have under a month.

steps.title: Contracts that doubled
steps.text: Amendments are normal; a doubling is a reason to read the contract.

steps.title: What the Controller found
steps.text: Most reviews find nothing. The organizations rated elevated concern are listed with the report page.
